title: When the Songbook Breaks Anew
author: Oscar Delacroix
blurb: Emrys Quintana, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
